purpose: Evidence inventory, not an executable Store install feed.
rules: Every GitHub project listed in the pinned README is accounted for, including non-app references.
Only observed manifest or catalog HMI declarations are recorded; unknown support is not converted to ID7 or ID8.
Repository HEAD is separate from the source commit of a release asset.
Shared component ids keep publisher identity; alternate publishers are not silently selected by higher version.
Original-source references are separate from permission to mirror or change upstream payloads.
All live head-unit installation results remain NOT OBSERVED.
